tools.name: search_foods
tools.description: Finds foods in the storage guide for a food word or a product name in Turkish, English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Japanese or Arabic (for example 'yoğurt', 'opened milk', 'Kaşar peyniri', 'Hähnchenbrust'). Returns up to 8 foods with their slug, a one-line summary and the page URL. U

tools.name: get_storage_guide
tools.description: Returns how long one food keeps in the fridge, freezer and pantry, for each state the guide lists (unopened, opened, cooked, ...), with the best way to store it, spoilage signs, freezing and thawing, myths, advice for people at higher risk, common questions, sources and the page URL.
